title: A portal browser session (cookies)
caption: What the portal's cookies say about a browser, and what moves it between states. The API keeps the matching account_sessions rows.

states.label: MFA challenge pending
states.detail: `__Host-vxp_mfa` (Strict, ≤5 min) and `__Host-vxp_next`; no session cookie yet.

states.label: Signed in, unverified
states.detail: Access token claim `ev: false`: only `/verify-pending` and sign-out.

states.label: Signed in
states.detail: Access token ≤15 min, refresh token until the family's 30 days.

states.label: Access token expiring
states.detail: Less than 30 s left, unreadable or missing with a refresh token present.

states.label: MFA enrolment required
states.detail: `getMe.mfaEnrolmentRequired` (owner/admin of a live OTA without MFA): only `/mfa-enrolment`.
